# Vendored reveal.js 5.1.0

These files are an unmodified subset of reveal.js 5.1.0, by Hakim El Hattab and
the reveal.js contributors, released under the MIT license (see `LICENSE` in this
directory). Lectern copies them into a deck's output when the deck sets
`[reveal] assets = "vendored"`.

Obtained from the npm tarball
`https://registry.npmjs.org/reveal.js/-/reveal.js-5.1.0.tgz`, whose registry
integrity is
`sha512-KDt7m0+xwKV6nAZt4CNPVFBf42sTKRQapg0bGGKB5PKO5XvChnMfwlZkybydHiQJ7p5+6LbHKRGrhXODdoNIaA==`
(sha1 `dfaa4631127e739aa8ebbaa425d653e72d799e66`).

Files kept, at their paths inside the tarball's `package/`:

- `LICENSE`
- `dist/reset.css`, `dist/reveal.css`, `dist/reveal.js`
- `plugin/markdown/markdown.js`, `plugin/notes/notes.js`,
  `plugin/highlight/highlight.js`

See the README's "Self-contained decks" section for how to update this copy.
